name: Athaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: These verses name the children of Judah and Benjamin who dwelt in Jerusalem: from Judah, Athaiah of the line of Perez, and Maaseiah of the line of Shiloni; from Benjamin, Sallu and his brethren.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
